react_result.final_narrative_text: The differentially abundant metabolite set is dominated by eicosanoids and lipid mediators derived from arachidonic acid, with near-perfect cross-paradigm agreement across three independent methods. RaMP multi-DB ORA returned WikiPathways WP:WP167 'Eicosanoid synthesis' as the top-ranked pathway with FDR 6.8e-14, hitting all five canonical eicosanoid substrates (5-HETE, 15-HETE, leukotriene A4, 15-deoxy-Δ12,14-PGJ2, arachidonic acid). Mummichog m/z-direct analysis independently ranked 'Arachidonic acid metabolism' as the top MUMM pathway (p=0.00059) with an 11-member overlap. MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA named KEGG:hsa00590 as its top hit, again with four of these same eicosanoids. Arachidonic acid (KEGG:C00219) is the unifying substrate driving all three paradigms: it is the shared parent of the 5- and 15-HETE positional isomers via distinct lipoxygenase reactions, the substrate for leukotriene A4 via 5-lipoxygenase, and the upstream precursor for 15-deoxy-PGJ2 via the COX-derived cyclopentenone prostaglandin route. The complete absence of Losartan (KEGG:C07072) from any hit pathway confirms the differentially abundant metabolites arise from endogenous lipid metabolism rather than direct drug accumulation. The biological story is one of broad suppression or redistribution of the arachidonic acid cascade: five distinct metabolic arms (5-LOX→HETEs/leukotrienes, 15-LOX→15-HETE, COX→cyclopentenone-PGJ2) are simultaneously perturbed, consistent with a treatment that either inhibits upstream phospholipase A2 release of arachidonic acid or acts as a systemic eicosanoid synthesis disruptor.
